=== about
Without a selector each top-level element morphs the page element with its id; multi-line HTML travels in one elements line per line; the last patch removes an element.
=== page
<ul id="messages"><li>old</li></ul><p id="typing">...</p>
=== input
event: ypy-patch-elements
data: elements <ul id="messages">
data: elements   <li>héllo</li>
data: elements </ul>

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: mode remove
data: selector #typing

=== dom
<ul id="messages">
  <li>héllo</li>
</ul>
